f.title: Monitor the safety of drug preparations throughout the permit validity period
f.statement: The pharmaceutical dealer holding a drug preparation permit shall monitor the safety of its drug preparations within the period designated by the central competent health authority under Article 45(1) of the Pharmaceutical Affairs Act, which is based on the validity period of the drug permit. The surveillance shall include: (1) establishing the drug safety surveillance plan (Article 5) and reporting under Article 6; (2) collecting new drug safety data and submitting reports under Articles 8 and 9; and (3) establishing, implementing and reporting on the risk assessment and control plan for drugs of specific types or ingredients under Article 10.
f.applicability: Taiwan; Traditional Chinese original text from the Laws & Regulations Database (as amended 15 April 2022). These Regulations take effect from 1 January 2023 (Article 16). Drug preparations under a permit. Under Article 4, these Regulations apply to a Chinese medicine (中藥) that is a new drug under Article 7 of the Act or a drug announced or approved under Article 10(1).
f.processes: Safety governance; Signal detection; Risk management & minimisation

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical dealer holding the drug preparation permit (藥商)
rows.deadline: Within the period designated under Article 45(1) of the Act, based on the validity period of the drug permit (Article 2)
rows.quote:
中央衛生主管機關依本法第四十五條第一項規定指定之期間，以藥品許可證有效期間為準。
 第 3 條 
 持有藥品製劑許可證之藥商（以下簡稱藥商）應於前條期間內，監視其藥品製劑之安全性。
 前項藥品安全性監視，應包括下列事項：
 一、第五條藥品安全性監視計畫之訂定及第六條之通報。
 二、第八條及第九條新藥安全性資料之蒐集及報告繳交。
 三、第十條特定種類或成分藥品風險評估及管控計畫之訂定、執行及報告繳交。
rows.review_note: Review: no change to the duty. Quote spans Articles 2-3 so the period link to the permit validity is proved. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified (應 = shall; Mandatory correct). Below 90: quote spans Articles 2-3 and carries the article heading line; the Article 4 Chinese-medicine scope in applicability comes from outside the quote.
rows.quote_en:
The period designated by the central competent health authority under Article 45, Paragraph 1 of this Act shall be based on the validity period of the drug permit.
Article 3
A pharmaceutical dealer holding a permit for a drug preparation (hereinafter "the pharmaceutical dealer") shall, within the period in the preceding article, monitor the safety of its drug preparations.
The drug safety surveillance in the preceding paragraph shall include the following matters:
1. Establishment of the drug safety surveillance plan under Article 5 and the reporting under Article 6.
2. Collection of new drug safety data and submission of reports under Articles 8 and 9.
3. Establishment and implementation of, and submission of reports on, the risk assessment and control plan for drugs of specific types or ingredients under Article 10.

f.title: Include the six required elements in the drug safety surveillance plan
f.statement: The drug safety surveillance plan established by the pharmaceutical dealer shall include: (1) planning, operation and management of the surveillance process; (2) sources of drug safety information and methods of collection; (3) evaluation and analysis of that information; (4) control measures for drugs with safety concerns; (5) responsibilities and authority of the dealer's internal personnel; and (6) planning and implementation of drug safety surveillance training courses.
f.applicability: Taiwan; Traditional Chinese original text from the Laws & Regulations Database (as amended 15 April 2022). These Regulations take effect from 1 January 2023 (Article 16).
f.processes: Safety governance; Training & competency; Safety intake & collection

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical dealer holding the drug preparation permit (藥商)
rows.quote:
藥商訂定之藥品安全性監視計畫，應包括下列事項：
 一、監視流程之規劃、運作及管理。
 二、藥品安全性資訊來源及蒐集方式。
 三、前款資訊之評估及分析。
 四、藥品有安全疑慮之管控措施。
 五、藥商內部人員之責任及職權。
 六、藥品安全監視教育訓練課程之規劃及實施。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Chinese item 4 is 藥品有安全疑慮之管控措施 (control measures for drugs with safety concerns); the MOJ English renders it "risk management". Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force, actor and numbers. 應 = Mandatory; actor 藥商 explicit; statement adds nothing.
rows.quote_en:
The drug safety surveillance plan established by the pharmaceutical dealer shall include the following matters:
1. Planning, operation and management of the surveillance process.
2. Sources of drug safety information and the methods of collecting it.
3. Evaluation and analysis of the information in the preceding item.
4. Control measures for drugs with safety concerns.
5. Responsibilities and authority of the pharmaceutical dealer's internal personnel.
6. Planning and implementation of drug safety surveillance training courses.

f.title: Report specified drug safety findings online within 3 days of awareness
f.statement: Where a drug falls under any of the following, the pharmaceutical dealer shall report it through the online system established by the central competent health authority within 3 days from the date of becoming aware: (1) a serious adverse drug reaction that is unexpected or occurs at a frequency higher than expected is found; (2) there is a need to evaluate adding or changing contraindications or restrictions on use; (3) the drug has been suspended from use or withdrawn from the market because of adverse reactions in any of the ten advanced pharmaceutical countries (Germany, the United States, the United Kingdom, France, Japan, Switzerland, Canada, Australia, Belgium and Sweden); (4) in a country other than those ten, the drug is to be suspended from use or withdrawn from the market because of adverse reactions and, on evaluation, it should be reported. A serious adverse drug reaction under item (1) means a situation under Article 4 of the Regulations for Reporting Serious Adverse Reactions of Medicaments.
f.legal_basis: Regulations for Reporting Serious Adverse Reactions of Medicaments Art 4
f.applicability: Taiwan; Traditional Chinese original text from the Laws & Regulations Database (as amended 15 April 2022). These Regulations take effect from 1 January 2023 (Article 16). Item 3 covers suspension or withdrawal in the ten named countries; item 4 covers other countries; items 1 and 2 state no country restriction.
f.exceptions: Item 4 (other countries) applies only where, on evaluation, the action should be reported.
f.systems: Central competent health authority online reporting system
f.processes: Submission operations; Signal management; Reporting policy

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical dealer holding the drug preparation permit (藥商)
rows.deadline: Within 3 days from the date the dealer becomes aware (自知悉之日起三日內)
rows.quote:
藥品有下列情形之一者，藥商應自知悉之日起三日內，至中央衛生主管機關建置之網路系統通報：
 一、發現未預期或超出預期發生頻率之嚴重藥品不良反應。
 二、有評估新增或變更禁忌、使用限制之必要。
 三、於德國、美國、英國、法國、日本、瑞士、加拿大、澳洲、比利時、瑞典共十國（以下簡稱十大醫藥先進國家），因不良反應被暫停使用或下市。
 四、於前款外其他國家，因不良反應應暫停使用或下市，經評估應通報。
 前項第一款所稱嚴重藥品不良反應，指嚴重藥物不良反應通報辦法第四條規定之情形。
systems: Central competent health authority online reporting system
rows.review_note: Review: applicability reworded to drop 'foreign' (the quote names the ten countries and 'other countries' only). Translation check: agrees in meaning, modal (應 = shall) and the 3-day clock from the date of awareness (自知悉之日起). Item 4 reads 因不良反應應暫停使用或下市; 應 here is read as 'is to be' suspended or withdrawn, while the MOJ English says 'is suspended or withdrawn'; marked (應) in quote_en. The Chinese, like the English, cites Article 4 of the serious ADR Regulations, but the 2024 version of those Regulations defines serious ADRs in Article 2, so the cross-reference is outdated in both languages. Double-check: Translation verified with a fix: statement item 4 aligned with quote_en (因不良反應應暫停使用或下市 read as "is to be suspended or withdrawn"). Below 90: item 4 wording (應 inside the condition) and item 2 (有評估...之必要) are ambiguous in the Chinese, and the cross-reference to Article 4 of the serious ADR Regulations is outdated; 3-day clock and 應 = Mandatory are otherwise clear.
rows.quote_en:
Where a drug falls under any of the following circumstances, the pharmaceutical dealer shall, within three days from the date of becoming aware of it, report it through the online system established by the central competent health authority:
1. An unexpected serious adverse drug reaction, or one occurring at a frequency higher than expected, is found.
2. There is a need to evaluate adding or changing contraindications or restrictions on use.
3. In Germany, the United States, the United Kingdom, France, Japan, Switzerland, Canada, Australia, Belgium or Sweden, ten countries in total (hereinafter "the ten advanced pharmaceutical countries"), the drug has been suspended from use or withdrawn from the market because of adverse reactions.
4. In a country other than those in the preceding item, the drug is to be (應) suspended from use or withdrawn from the market because of adverse reactions, and on evaluation it should be reported.
A serious adverse drug reaction referred to in item 1 of the preceding paragraph means a situation provided in Article 4 of the Regulations for Reporting Serious Adverse Reactions of Medicaments.

f.title: Implement risk control measures required by the authority
f.statement: Where a drug falls under any situation in Article 6(1), the central competent health authority may (得) require the pharmaceutical dealer to implement one or more of the following risk control measures: (1) issuing a warning or a similar communication; (2) revising the package insert; (3) submitting a drug safety report; (4) suspending use and sale; (5) product recall; (6) other necessary measures. The dealer's duty to implement a measure arises only when the authority requires it; once required, the dealer must implement it.
f.applicability: Taiwan; Traditional Chinese original text from the Laws & Regulations Database (as amended 15 April 2022). These Regulations take effect from 1 January 2023 (Article 16).
f.exceptions: Applies only when the authority requires the measures (authority discretion: 得).
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Safety labeling; Safety communications

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical dealer, when required by the central competent health authority
rows.quote:
藥品有前條第一項各款情事之一者，中央衛生主管機關得要求藥商執行下列風險管控措施：
 一、發布警訊或其他相類之方式。
 二、修訂仿單。
 三、繳交藥品安全性報告。
 四、暫停使用及販售。
 五、產品回收。
 六、其他必要措施。
rows.review_note: Review: statement restated so the dealer's duty arises only when the authority requires the measure (得 is the authority's power; the company's duty to comply is Mandatory). Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force, actor and numbers. Below 90: 得要求 is the authority's power; the dealer's Mandatory duty to implement arises only on the authority's order and is not stated by the quote itself.
rows.quote_en:
Where a drug falls under any of the circumstances in the items of Paragraph 1 of the preceding article, the central competent health authority may require the pharmaceutical dealer to implement the following risk control measures:
1. Issuing a warning or by another similar means.
2. Revising the package insert.
3. Submitting a drug safety report.
4. Suspending use and sale.
5. Product recall.
6. Other necessary measures.

f.title: Submit periodic safety reports for five years and a summary report for new drugs
f.statement: For a new drug under Article 7 of the Pharmaceutical Affairs Act, the pharmaceutical dealer shall submit drug safety periodic reports (Annex 1) to the central competent health authority within five years from the date the authority issues the drug permit (the issue date), and, when the period expires, submit a drug safety summary report (Annex 2). The data lock points (DLP) of the periodic reports run from the issue date in six-month periods for the first and second years and in one-year periods for the remaining three years.
f.applicability: Taiwan; Traditional Chinese original text from the Laws & Regulations Database (as amended 15 April 2022). These Regulations take effect from 1 January 2023 (Article 16). New drugs under Article 7 of the Pharmaceutical Affairs Act.
f.systems: Annex 1 periodic report; Annex 2 summary report

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical dealer holding the drug preparation permit (藥商)
rows.deadline: Periodic reports for 5 years from the permit issue date (DLP every 6 months in years 1-2, every year in the remaining 3 years); summary report when the 5-year period expires
rows.quote:
藥商應自中央衛生主管機關核發本法第七條新藥藥品許可證之日（以下簡稱發證日）起五年內，向該主管機關繳交藥品安全性定期報告（如附件一）；期滿時，繳交藥品安全性總結報告（如附件二）。
 前項定期報告之資料蒐集截止日（Data Lock Point，DLP），自發證日起，第一年、第二年，以每六個月為一期，其餘三年，以每年為一期。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Chinese 期滿時 means when the five-year period expires; the MOJ English says the summary report is due 'upon expiration of the said Permit', which is a substantive difference; the statement follows the Chinese. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force, actor and numbers. 應 = Mandatory carries over to 期滿時繳交; actor, 5-year period and DLP periods explicit; statement adds nothing. The 90-day submission clock is in -0007 and the DLP recalculation option in -0006.
rows.quote_en:
The pharmaceutical dealer shall, within five years from the date on which the central competent health authority issues the drug permit for a new drug under Article 7 of this Act (hereinafter "the issue date"), submit drug safety periodic reports (see Annex 1) to that authority; when the period expires, it shall submit a drug safety summary report (see Annex 2).
The data lock points (Data Lock Point, DLP) of the periodic reports in the preceding paragraph shall, from the issue date, be every six months as one period for the first and second years, and every year as one period for the remaining three years.

f.title: Option to apply to recalculate data lock points within 3 months
f.statement: Within three months from the day after receiving notice to collect the new drug permit, the pharmaceutical dealer may apply to the central competent health authority to recalculate the data lock points, submitting: (1) the international birth date (IBD), or the start date of the Periodic Safety Update Report (PSUR) approved in the ten advanced pharmaceutical countries; and (2) the planned data lock point of each report period, with no interval between periods exceeding one year.
f.applicability: Taiwan; Traditional Chinese original text from the Laws & Regulations Database (as amended 15 April 2022). These Regulations take effect from 1 January 2023 (Article 16). New drugs under Article 7 of the Pharmaceutical Affairs Act.
f.exceptions: The planned interval between report periods shall not exceed one year (不得超過一年).

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical dealer holding the drug preparation permit (藥商)
rows.deadline: Within 3 months from the day after receipt of the notice to collect the permit
rows.quote:
藥商得於接獲領取第一項許可證通知之次日起三個月內，檢具下列資料，向中央衛生主管機關申請重新計算資料蒐集截止日：
 一、國際最早核准日期（International birth date，IBD）或十大醫藥先進國家核准之藥品安全性報告（Periodic Safety Update Report，PSUR）起算日。
 二、各期報告資料蒐集截止日之規劃。但各期間隔，不得超過一年。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Level Permitted follows 得 (the company's own option). Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force, actor and numbers. 得 is the dealer's own option = Permitted; the 不得超過一年 interval cap is kept as a condition; actor and 3-month window (from the day after notice) explicit.
rows.quote_en:
The pharmaceutical dealer may, within three months from the day after receiving notice to collect the permit in Paragraph 1, submit the following documents and apply to the central competent health authority to recalculate the data lock points:
1. The international earliest approval date (International birth date, IBD), or the start date of the drug safety report (Periodic Safety Update Report, PSUR) approved in the ten advanced pharmaceutical countries.
2. The plan of the data lock point of each report period. However, the interval between periods shall not exceed one year.

deadline_rule.clock_start: 接獲領取第一項許可證通知之次日
deadline_rule.applies_to: Optional application to recalculate the data lock points of periodic safety reports for a new drug (IBD-based schedule)

f.title: Submit periodic and summary reports within 90 days after each data lock point
f.statement: The periodic reports and the summary report under Article 8(1) shall be submitted within 90 days after the data lock point of each period is reached.
f.applicability: Taiwan; Traditional Chinese original text from the Laws & Regulations Database (as amended 15 April 2022). These Regulations take effect from 1 January 2023 (Article 16). New drugs under Article 7 of the Pharmaceutical Affairs Act.

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical dealer holding the drug preparation permit (藥商)
rows.deadline: Within 90 days after the data lock point of each period is reached
rows.quote: 第一項定期及總結報告，應於各期資料蒐集截止日屆至後九十日內繳交。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Clock: 90 days after each data lock point is reached (屆至後九十日內). Translation check: agrees. Below 90: the quote is passive (報告...應於...繳交) and does not name the actor; dealer inferred from Article 8(1).
rows.quote_en: The periodic and summary reports in Paragraph 1 shall be submitted within ninety days after the data lock point of each period is reached.

f.title: Continue data collection and reporting for a period designated by the authority
f.statement: After receiving the summary report under Article 8(1), the central competent health authority may (得), where it considers it necessary, designate a period and require the pharmaceutical dealer to continue the data collection and report submission under Article 8; the designation is not limited to once. The dealer's duty arises only when the authority so designates; once designated, the dealer must continue collection and reporting for that period.
f.applicability: Taiwan; Traditional Chinese original text from the Laws & Regulations Database (as amended 15 April 2022). These Regulations take effect from 1 January 2023 (Article 16).
f.exceptions: Applies only when the authority designates a further period (authority discretion: 得).

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical dealer, when required by the central competent health authority
rows.deadline: For the period designated by the authority
rows.quote: 中央衛生主管機關接獲前條第一項總結報告，認有必要者，得指定期間要求藥商續行前條之資料蒐集及報告繳交；其指定不以一次為限。
rows.review_note: Review: statement restated so the dealer's duty arises only on the authority's designation (得 = authority power; compliance Mandatory). Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force, actor and numbers. Below 90: 得指定期間要求 is the authority's power; the dealer's duty arises only on the authority's designation and the period is set case by case.
rows.quote_en: Where the central competent health authority, upon receiving the summary report in Paragraph 1 of the preceding article, considers it necessary, it may designate a period and require the pharmaceutical dealer to continue the data collection and report submission under the preceding article; such designation is not limited to once.

f.title: Establish a risk assessment and control plan within 3 months and implement it after approval
f.statement: The central competent health authority may (得) announce or approve (核定) drugs of specific types or ingredients and require the pharmaceutical dealer to establish a risk assessment and control plan (Annex 3). The dealer's duty arises only for drugs so announced or approved: within three months from the date of announcement or approval, it must establish the plan, submit it to the authority, and implement it after approval. The plan includes the methods of risk assessment and control, the deadlines for submitting reports, and other implementation matters.
f.applicability: Taiwan; Traditional Chinese original text from the Laws & Regulations Database (as amended 15 April 2022). These Regulations take effect from 1 January 2023 (Article 16). Drugs of specific types or ingredients announced or approved by the authority under Article 10(1).
f.exceptions: Applies only to drugs the authority announces or approves under Article 10(1) (authority discretion: 得).
f.systems: Annex 3 risk assessment and control plan

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical dealer, when required by the central competent health authority (announcement or approval under Article 10(1))
rows.deadline: Within 3 months from the date of announcement or approval (自公告或核定之日起三個月內)
rows.quote:
中央衛生主管機關得公告或核定特定種類或成分之藥品，要求藥商自公告或核定之日起三個月內，訂定執行風險評估及管控計畫（如附件三），報中央衛生主管機關核准後執行。
 前項計畫之內容，包括風險評估與管控之方式、報告繳交期限及其他執行事項。
systems: Annex 3 risk assessment and control plan
rows.review_note: Review: statement restated so the duty arises only for drugs the authority announces or approves; actor aligned. Chinese reads 自公告或核定之日起 (from the date of announcement OR approval) where the MOJ English reads 'date of announcement of approval'; Chinese 報...核准後執行 (submit for approval, then implement) states implementation as part of the duty, where the English says 'before it may be enforced'. rows.quote_en:
The central competent health authority may announce or approve drugs of specific types or ingredients and require the pharmaceutical dealer, within three months from the date of announcement or approval, to establish a risk assessment and control plan for implementation (see Annex 3) and submit it to the central competent health authority, to be implemented after approval.
The content of the plan in the preceding paragraph includes the methods of risk assessment and control, the deadlines for submitting reports, and other implementation matters.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Risk assessment and control plan for drug types or ingredients announced or designated by the authority

f.title: Obtain approval before implementing changes to the risk assessment and control plan
f.statement: Any change to the content of the risk assessment and control plan shall be submitted to the central competent health authority, and the changed plan may be implemented only after the authority approves the change. This does not apply to changes of: (1) the name, address, contact place, telephone or fax number of the pharmaceutical dealer or manufacturer; or (2) the name or address of a distributor.
f.applicability: Taiwan; Traditional Chinese original text from the Laws & Regulations Database (as amended 15 April 2022). These Regulations take effect from 1 January 2023 (Article 16). Risk assessment and control plans under Article 10(1).
f.exceptions: No prior approval needed for changes to the dealer/manufacturer name, address, contact place, telephone or fax number, or the distributor name or address.

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical dealer holding the drug preparation permit (藥商)
rows.quote:
前項計畫內容有變更者，應報中央衛生主管機關核准變更後，始得據以執行。但下列情形之變更，不在此限：
 一、藥商或製造廠之名稱、地址、聯絡處所、電話或傳真號碼。
 二、經銷商名稱或地址。

rows.quote_en:
Where the content of the plan in the preceding paragraph is changed, the change shall be submitted to the central competent health authority, and the plan may be implemented accordingly only after the authority approves the change. However, this does not apply to changes in the following:
1. The name, address, contact place, telephone or fax number of the pharmaceutical dealer or manufacturer.
2. The name or address of a distributor.

f.title: Submit a report on completed work within 60 days of business suspension or closure
f.statement: Where the pharmaceutical dealer applies to suspend or close its business so that the periodic or summary reports under Article 8 or 9 cannot be submitted, or the risk assessment and control plan under Article 10 has not been fully implemented, the dealer shall submit a report on the part already performed within 60 days from the date the suspension or closure occurs.
f.applicability: Taiwan; Traditional Chinese original text from the Laws & Regulations Database (as amended 15 April 2022). These Regulations take effect from 1 January 2023 (Article 16).
f.processes: Aggregate reporting; Risk management & minimisation; Submission operations

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical dealer holding the drug preparation permit (藥商)
rows.deadline: Within 60 days from the date the suspension or closure of business occurs (自停、歇業事實發生日起六十日內)
rows.quote: 藥商申請停業或歇業，致第八條或第九條藥品安全性定期及總結報告未能繳交，或前條藥品風險評估及管控計畫未執行完竣者，應自停、歇業事實發生日起六十日內，就已執行部分，繳交報告

f.title: Complete outstanding reports and plan on resuming business
f.statement: Where a pharmaceutical dealer that suspended or closed its business, leaving the Article 8 or 9 reports unsubmitted or the Article 10 risk assessment and control plan not fully implemented, later resumes business, it shall continue and complete them.
f.applicability: Taiwan; Traditional Chinese original text from the Laws & Regulations Database (as amended 15 April 2022). These Regulations take effect from 1 January 2023 (Article 16).

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical dealer holding the drug preparation permit (藥商)
rows.deadline: On later resumption of business (no time limit stated)
rows.quote: 藥商申請停業或歇業，致第八條或第九條藥品安全性定期及總結報告未能繳交，或前條藥品風險評估及管控計畫未執行完竣者，應自停、歇業事實發生日起六十日內，就已執行部分，繳交報告；其嗣後復業者，應接續予以完成。

rows.quote_en: Where a pharmaceutical dealer applies for suspension or closure of business, as a result of which the drug safety periodic and summary reports under Article 8 or Article 9 cannot be submitted, or the drug risk assessment and control plan under the preceding article has not been fully implemented, it shall, within sixty days from the date on which the suspension or closure occurs, submit a report on the part already performed; if it later resumes business, it shall continue and complete them.

f.title: Retain drug safety surveillance records for 5 years after permit expiry
f.statement: The pharmaceutical dealer shall retain the drug safety surveillance data under these Regulations for five years after the validity period of the drug permit expires. The data include the original data, files, documents and literature on which the plans or reports were based.
f.applicability: Taiwan; Traditional Chinese original text from the Laws & Regulations Database (as amended 15 April 2022). These Regulations take effect from 1 January 2023 (Article 16).

rows.quote_en:

The data in the preceding paragraph include the original data, files, documents and literature on which the completion of such plans or reports was based.

f.title: Hand over surveillance data on permit transfer; transferee continues surveillance
f.statement: Where the central competent health authority approves the transfer registration of a drug permit, the transferring pharmaceutical dealer shall deliver the drug safety surveillance data to the transferee dealer, and the transferee shall continue the surveillance and retention in accordance with these Regulations.
f.applicability: Taiwan; Traditional Chinese original text from the Laws & Regulations Database (as amended 15 April 2022). These Regulations take effect from 1 January 2023 (Article 16).

f.title: Do not evade, obstruct or refuse surveillance inspections or data requests
f.statement: The central competent health authority may send personnel to inspect the pharmaceutical dealer's drug safety surveillance operations or require it to provide related data; the dealer shall not evade, obstruct or refuse.
f.applicability: Taiwan; Traditional Chinese original text from the Laws & Regulations Database (as amended 15 April 2022). These Regulations take effect from 1 January 2023 (Article 16).

f.title: Write plans and reports in Traditional Chinese or English
f.statement: Plans and reports under these Regulations shall be written in Traditional Chinese or English; any attachment not in Traditional Chinese or English shall be accompanied by a Traditional Chinese or English translation.
f.applicability: Taiwan; Traditional Chinese original text from the Laws & Regulations Database (as amended 15 April 2022). These Regulations take effect from 1 January 2023 (Article 16).

f.title: Comply with the Personal Data Protection Act when handling personal data for surveillance
f.statement: Where the pharmaceutical dealer needs to collect, process or use personal data to carry out drug safety surveillance, it shall do so in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Act and related regulations.
f.applicability: Taiwan; Traditional Chinese original text from the Laws & Regulations Database (as amended 15 April 2022). These Regulations take effect from 1 January 2023 (Article 16).
